entry.title: Updated: dsh-voice
entry.summary: Full-duplex voice mode for the Web UI: a composer mic (RMS endpoint detection) transcribes speech with whisper running locally in the browser, assistant replies stream back as spoken audio sentence-by-sentence, and speaking interrupts playback and the running turn (true barge-in). No API key. Exact install spec: github:haoku123/dsh-voice. Source event: zoahdev/dsh-subscribe; changed: sources.
